verdict.rationale: The only computer-operation evidence is 'Grok Bot', which hands work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer, not the user's own machine. Connectors and custom MCP tunneling reach data and tools through APIs and servers rather than letting Grok see and operate desktop applications. Missing for 10: documented local computer-use (screen viewing and mouse/keyboard control of apps on the user's computer), detailed docs on Grok Bot's app-operation capabilities, permission/safety controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
